sources.title: Stanford HAI 2026 AI Index — Economy
sources.claim: Organizational AI adoption reached 88% in 2025 while AI-agent deployment remained in the single digits across nearly all business functions.
sources.use: Base-rate control: broad AI adoption cannot stand in for agentic-AI maturity.

sources.title: McKinsey — The state of AI in 2026: On the road to ROI
sources.claim: 40% of respondents at organizations above $1B revenue reported scaling AI agents, versus 22% at smaller organizations.
sources.use: Shows agent scaling is increasing but uneven by organization size; survey evidence is directional.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol — 2026-07-28 Specification
sources.claim: The July 2026 MCP release introduced a stateless core, authorization hardening, formal extensions and updated SDKs.
sources.use: Interoperability/tool-connectivity ecosystem is maturing; does not prove application reliability.

sources.title: Linux Foundation — A2A Protocol one-year adoption update
sources.claim: A2A reported support from more than 150 organizations and production deployments across multiple industries.
sources.use: Evidence that agent-to-agent interoperability is becoming an enterprise ecosystem signal.

sources.title: DHL Group Q3 2026 Roadshow Presentation — Shipment Booking & Enrichment
sources.claim: DHL reports agentic data extraction/system integration for 2.5M annual air/ocean freight booking requests, human-in-loop validation, and a 40% productivity gain.
sources.use: Strong logistics production analogue; not evidence that autonomous freight-invoice payment approval is mainstream.

sources.title: DHL Logistics Trend Radar 8.0 — Agentic AI
sources.claim: DHL classifies Agentic AI as high impact with adoption under five years and describes early logistics implementations moving beyond pilots into production.
sources.use: Operator foresight and examples; treat forecasts as directional and hype-sensitive.

sources.title: DHL Logistics Trend Radar 8.0 press release
sources.claim: DHL identifies Agentic AI as one of the most impactful new logistics trends and emphasizes human expertise and governance alongside autonomy.
sources.use: Supports logistics relevance, not market-wide maturity.
